title: Prediction of cytotoxicity of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons from first principles.
authors: Kim, Taewoo; Zhen, Juyuan; Lee, Junghyun; Park, Shin Yeong; Lee, Changkeun; Kwon, Bong-Oh; Hong, Seongjin; Shin, Hyeong-Moo; Giesy, John P; Chang, Gap Soo; Khim, Jong Seong
journal: The Science of the total environment
one_liner_zh: 该文用基于第一性原理的DRBF模型结合分子动力学模拟预测多环芳烃与芳烃受体蛋白的结合及细胞毒性，属于广义蛋白-配体互作而非TF-DNA体系，但分子动力学与结合建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Ligand-specific binding interactions of xenobiotics with receptor proteins form the basis of cytotoxicity-based hazard assessment. Computational approaches enable predictive hazard assessment for a large number of chemicals in a high-throughput manner, minimizing the use of animal testing. However, in silico models for predicting mechanisms of toxic actions and potencies are difficult to develop because toxicity datasets or comprehensive understanding of the complicated kinetic process of ligand-receptor interactions are needed for model development. In this study, a directional reactive binding factor (DRBF) model based on first principles was used to predict cytotoxicity potencies of agonists of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) for 16 different polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs). Molecular dynamics were simulated by accounting for the directional configuration factor toward receptor protein and the factor of binding to the Per-Arnt-Sim (PAS) domain. When comparing the experimental results of toxic potencies from in vitro bioassays with the predictions among two different in silico models, including quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) and molecular docking models, the DRBF model exhibited the highest model performance (R(2) = 0.90 and p < 0.01). Our results showed that the DRBF model based on first principles and molecular and computational structural biology could serve as a novel framework to advance next generation hazard assessment for high-throughput screening of chemical substances.
abstract_zh: 外源物质与受体蛋白之间的配体特异性结合相互作用构成了基于细胞毒性的危害评估基础。计算方法能够以高通量方式对大量化学品进行预测性危害评估，从而最大限度地减少动物试验的使用。然而，由于毒性数据集或对配体-受体相互作用复杂动力学过程的全面理解是模型开发所必需的，因此用于预测毒性作用机制和效力的计算机模拟模型难以建立。本研究采用基于第一性原理的方向性反应结合因子（DRBF）模型，预测了16种不同多环芳烃（PAHs）对芳烃受体（AhR）激动剂的细胞毒性效力。通过考虑朝向受体蛋白的方向性构型因子以及与Per-Arnt-Sim（PAS）结构域结合的因素，进行了分子动力学模拟。在将体外生物测定实验得到的毒性效力结果与两种不同计算机模拟模型（包括定量构效关系（QSAR）和分子对接模型）的预测进行比较时，DRBF模型表现出最高的模型性能（R(2) = 0.90，p < 0.01）。我们的结果表明，基于第一性原理及分子和计算结构生物学的DRBF模型，可作为推进下一代化学物质高通量筛选危害评估的新框架。
